name: IIFL Capital Services Ltd
title: IIFL Capital Services Ltd - 542773 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 operational revenue up 20% YoY to INR644 crore, but operational PBT fell 22% for FY26 on employee costs; no capacity or supply signal, and management was evasive on the fundraise and Fairfax stake.

triggers.label: Q4 operational revenue up 20% YoY
triggers.quote: Operational revenues were INR644 crores versus INR537 crores, up 20%.

triggers.label: FY26 operational PBT down 22%
triggers.quote: Operational PBT was down 22%, and that is basically -- primarily driven by increase in the employee expenses.

triggers.label: Evasion on fundraise and Fairfax stake
triggers.quote: I can't offer any comments on this.

red_flags.label: Evasive on capital raise and Fairfax stake
red_flags.quote: So at this point in time, I can't share more with you because there's no event that requires disclosure

red_flags.label: Tax search and INR56 crore notices
red_flags.quote: we have got a notice which for roughly -- for both IIFL management and IIFL facilities for roughly about INR56 crores combined
